title: Co-located differential spectrometer: M2 vs S2 in the quartz-minus-atomic differential cross-spectrum
design: Multi-day FFT of co-located (internal - external_atomic) differential. Cross-spectrum with remote stations at each tidal frequency. The differential cancels satellite, atmospheric, orbital, and processing common-mode. The cross-spectrum with remote stations isolates the distance-structured gravitational component from local atmospheric effects.
prediction: TEP: M2 (lunar, gravitational) shows distance structure in the differential cross-spectrum; S2 (solar, atmospheric) does not. Atmospheric: S2 shows distance structure; M2 does not. Null: neither shows distance structure.
